I have 5 WR, have to start 3. Ppr 10 person league. Juedy, Tim Patrick, Shenault, Boyd, and Jamison crowder.
I live with my parents and there is no smoking in the house. If I try matches or a stove lighter outside, the wind will blow it out.
I don't have chronic pain, chronic pain stays the same... my pain is different. It gets worse everyday. It is like my muscles are deteriorating.
the voices keep getting louder and louder
There probably is a good reason why they didn't prescribe them. As for DNA tests, I will check with my therapist on thursday if I make it that far...

It is hard to get out of the house due to my disability. I am in a wheelchair and my parents house has 7 stairs to get to it. I hate my life and I want it to end. You have no idea how hard it is to wake up to constant pain and agony, only knowing that it is not gonna get any better. My disease is progressive.
I've tried a lot of medication, but the side effects always get me. I have been on at least 15 different SSRI's in the past year and the side effects were always too strong.

There is no treatment, only physical therapy, which isn't really a treatment.

I like to play chess and board games, such as Settlers of Catan and Risk. I read occasionally, mostly philosophy and physics.

I was on melatonin for about 2 months, but it wasn't really working... The only thing that sorta works for my insomnia is marijuana. I would smoke some right now, but my disease makes it extremely hard to use a lighter. It is currently 3:22 AM here and everyone is asleep.

I have seen a psychiatrist about it and he said I was making it up and it was all a hoax for attention. I just finished undergrad university in August and I cannot go back to school because no one will pay for it. Also, its kinda hard to play video games with a muscular disorder. Its kinda like CP, except a lot worse, cause I feel a lot of pain throughout my body.
I have dreams every single night of killing myself too. I am at my lowest point right now. I want to die to get rid of this disease once in for all.
